en: Fill Products with your catalogue (SKU, cost, web price, supplier) and Suppliers and Team with the people your messages go to.
mt: 在“产品”中填写您的目录（SKU、成本、网络价格、供应商），在“供应商”和“团队”中填写您的消息的接收者。

en: Record each return on Returns: date, order, customer, SKU, reason, status, refund and restock decision. The refund check and the net cost fill in by themselves.
mt: 在退货中记录每次退货：日期、订单、客户、SKU、原因、状态、退款和补货决定。退款支票和净费用自行填写。

en: Record reviews on Reviews and reply to low-star ones; see disputes on Disputes and win-back vouchers on Win-back Vouchers.
mt: 在Reviews上记录评论并回复低星级的；请参阅 赢回优惠券 上的争议和赢回凭证。

en: Uses left, 0 when there is no limit
Hello, {name} spent {spend_4w} in four weeks against a budget of {budget_4w}. Please check the bids and tell me what you change today.
mt: 您好，{name} 在四个星期内花费了 {spend_4w}，预算为 {budget_4w}。请检查出价并告诉我您今天更改了什么。
